title: Element file frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of an element file (D-015, D-056). The Markdown text follows the closing `---`. Only `id`, `type` and `status` are structural (`status` only for a type with statuses, ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#306); every other key is a property or relation kind key from the metamodel (D-043). Keys the metamodel does not know are kept unchanged and reported as hints (D-012, SR-016). See docs/adr/0004-element-file-format.md. File name: type prefix, dash, last 12 hex characters of the UUID, never changed (D-056). Value kinds are checked against the metamodel, not by this schema, so any value of an unknown key is kept (SR-016); `$defs/value` describes the values ReqSeq writes.

status.description: Status key from the metamodel, one of the statuses of the element's type (ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#306). Left out for a type without status. Only ever set by a person (D-030, SR-017).

normal-form.description: Reserved. Never written; the normal-form version is part of every stored version string (D-027).

criterion.description: An acceptance criterion with its criterion key, as the element file stores it (D-072, SR-204, ADR-0004): a block mapping, key first. Only in the list of the property with the meaning acceptance-criteria; the key never counts to the version (D-027).

key.description: The criterion key: a lower-case letter a to z, then 3 to 15 lower-case letters a to z or digits (SR-204 AK5); unique in the requirement and kept while the criterion exists.

text.description: The text of the acceptance criterion, Markdown.

inputValue.description: Property value of a write command: like `value`, but a relation target is an element reference (UUID, short ID or identifier, alone or as `{ id, repository? }`) whose version ReqSeq sets (SR-021).

value.description: Property value (text, number, date as YYYY-MM-DD, choice key, list) or relation targets. Which one is expected comes from the metamodel; a mismatch is a hint, not a parse error (SR-012 AK3).
